chunks: And indeed the Judgement will indeed take place.
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Al-Din' refer to in the context of the certainty of Judgement in Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mursalat underscores the inevitability of divine recompense, with 'Al-Din' interpreted as the final accounting that will manifest with absolute certainty. This concept reinforces the theological principle of 'Adl (Divine Justice), assuring believers that their deeds will be weighed without error. The phrasing serves as a powerful reminder of the transient nature of worldly life compared to the eternal reality of the Hereafter.
